html:
G'oya

Ikki qadam. Avval film bo'yicha tushum: filmlarni seanslarga, seanslarni qaytarilmagan chiptalarga ulab, SUM(price). Keyin har janr ichida shu tushum bo'yicha o'rin. O'rin qoidasi shartda yozilgan: teng tushum bir xil o'rin, keyingi o'rin sakraydi. Bu RANK.

Yechim

WITH rev AS (
  SELECT f.id, f.genre, f.title, SUM(t.price) AS revenue
  FROM films f
  JOIN sessions s ON s.film_id = f.id
  JOIN tickets t ON t.session_id = s.id
  WHERE t.refunded = 0
  GROUP BY f.id, f.genre, f.title
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT genre, title, revenue,
         RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY genre ORDER BY revenue DESC) AS place
  FROM rev
)
SELECT genre, title, revenue
FROM ranked
WHERE place <= 2

Guruhlash film bo'yicha (f.id), seans bo'yicha emas: Sarob ikki seansda 100 000 va 60 000 yig'gan, jami 160 000. Chiptalari hammasi qaytarilgan Daryo WHERE dan keyin umuman qolmaydi va o'rin olmaydi.

Tuzoqlar

Uchta o'rin funksiyasining farqi namunada ko'rinadi. Dramada Kuz va Tun 100 000 dan: ROW_NUMBER ulardan birini tashlaydi. Komediyada Kulgu va Hazil birinchi o'rinda teng: DENSE_RANK Qahqahaga 2 beradi va u ham natijaga kiradi, RANK esa 3.

Noto'g'riWITH rev AS (
  SELECT f.id, f.genre, f.title, SUM(t.price) AS revenue
  FROM films f
  JOIN sessions s ON s.film_id = f.id
  JOIN tickets t ON t.session_id = s.id
  WHERE t.refunded = 0
  GROUP BY f.id, f.genre, f.title
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT genre, title, revenue,
         DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY genre ORDER BY revenue DESC) AS place
  FROM rev
)
SELECT genre, title, revenue
FROM ranked
WHERE place <= 2

Qaytarilgan chiptalarni ham qo'shsangiz, Kuzning qaytarilgan 80 000 lik chiptasi uni birinchi o'ringa chiqaradi. Shartni SUM(CASE ...) ichiga yozsangiz ham xato: Daryo 0 tushum bilan qoladi va Sarguzashtda ikkinchi o'rinni oladi.
